WITH year_ends AS (
    SELECT (date '1812-01-01' + (n * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') - INTERVAL '1 DAY') as dec31
    FROM range(0, 213) as t(n)
)
SELECT dec31 FROM year_ends ORDER BY dec31 LIMIT 5
